title: [main] Closing the BC browser tab during quote-to-order reservation leaves a partial sales order and the source quote
summary: Quote-to-order conversion now defers automatic reservation until the entire conversion completes, preventing partial orders and orphaned quotes when the browser session closes.
key_points: Defer manual reservation until conversion completes
Prevents partial order preservation when browser tab closes during conversion
Eliminates orphaned quote records alongside incomplete orders
Adds comprehensive test coverage for interruption scenarios
Applied to all affected localization layers
quote: Defer manual reservation until conversion completes, so interruption cannot preserve a partially converted order.
